SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT   (PRELIMINARY)

clearance. Tumour measures 32 x 24 mm, upper outer quadrant.

Lymphovascular invasion present. Margins free, nearest 4 mm.

IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY: ER negative. PR negative. HER2 IHC 2+ (equivocal).

HER2 FISH: to follow. Will be issued as an ADDITIONAL REPORT.

STATUS: PRELIMINARY. Final report pending FISH.
